editorial.blurb: A hidden-gem omakase sanctuary on Sushi-San's second floor where Chef Kaze orchestrates an 18-course journey of pristine fish flown fresh from Japan and Spain in an intimate, secluded lounge.
editorial.insiderTip: Arrive early to enjoy the extensive drink menu in the private lounge before the curtains open to reveal the sushi bar—pair your omakase with the spirit-free cocktail option for a balanced, elevated experience.
